name: Shell
description: What the shell itself reads and writes, which is not one app's: the chat's history, and (in the blocks the other shell lanes add) Home, search and the vault's plumbing. It is parsed like an app manifest and is not one of the eight apps: the assistant's catalogue and the training harness do not carry it.

queries.name: chats
queries.description: The chat drawer's list, newest activity first; with a term, the chats it finds by title and by the member's own words, best first, with the words it corrected a typo to.

queries.name: chat
queries.description: One stored chat and its messages, oldest first, each with its cards and attachments as they were said.

queries.name: chat-card
queries.description: Whether the row a stored card names is still in the vault.

actions.name: rename-chat
phrasings: change the title of this chat
actions.description: Rename a stored chat through thread.rename.

actions.name: delete-chat
actions.description: Delete one stored chat with its messages for good through entity.purge: a chat has no trash.

actions.name: clear-chats
actions.description: Delete every stored chat in this vault for good through thread.clear.
